fluff.overview: The Com Guards field conventional infantry as a core component of their combined-arms formations, with Level I infantry units integrated into the same command structure alongside BattleMech, armor, and aerospace elements at every organizational level. Motorized Level I formations use light vehicles to achieve rapid redeployment between positions, trading the armor protection of mechanized transports for greater speed and lower logistical burden. These formations excel at screening operations and can cover more ground than foot infantry during extended patrol assignments. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
